note: Hand-checked case of px4_commander: a healthy X500 on the ground (SITL parameters), an arm command and a mode change, ticks worked out from Commander.cpp.  Schedule of the commander task. At init it runs one pass at t = 0 and sleeps 10 ms (Commander.cpp:1979, COMMANDER_MONITORING_INTERVAL); a pass runs at the first step whose t_us is past the deadline: step 0 (t = 1 s), then every 4th step (t = 1.01 s, 1.02 s, ...), since each pass ends in a 10 ms sleep when no command is waiting (:1977-1980). Step 0 (t = 1 s): pass; the 2 Hz rule (now >= vehicle_status.timestamp + 500 ms, :1932) publishes   actuator_armed, vehicle_control_mode and vehicle_status: disarmed (arming_state 1), nav_state 4   AUTO_LOITER (the initial user intention, UserModeIntention.hpp:100, kept without RC). Step 2 (t = 1.005 s): COMPONENT_ARM_DISARM (400, param1 1) from the GCS (255/190). Commander sleeps. Step 4 (t = 1.01 s): pass; the command is read (:1888-1898), Commander::arm runs the arming checks   (:610) and sets arming_state ARMED (:622); handle_command returns true, so _status_changed and   the block at :1932-1946 publishes actuator_armed.armed = true (:1918), vehicle_control_mode with   flag_armed, vehicle_status with arming_state 2, all stamped 1010000; the ACCEPTED (0) ack goes to   255/190 (answer_command, :1553). Steps 5-7: no pass, nothing published. Step 9 (t = 1.0225 s): DO_SET_MODE (176, param1 1 = custom mode, param2 4 = AUTO, param3 2 =   TAKEOFF). Step 12 (t = 1.03 s): pass; DO_SET_MODE (:800-930) maps it to AUTO_TAKEOFF (17) and   _user_mode_intention.change accepts it (:915): ACCEPTED ack, status published (still nav_state 4:   the published nav state is set in handleModeIntentionAndFailsafe, which ran before the command,   :1866 and :2369-2373). Step 16 (t = 1.04 s): pass; handleModeIntentionAndFailsafe sets   nav_state = nav_state_user_intention = 17 and nav_state_timestamp = 1040000, nav_state changed:   status published; control mode for 17 = auto, position, velocity, altitude, climb rate,   attitude, rates, allocation (control_mode.cpp, the AUTO group), as for 4, and   multicopter_position_control on (rotary wing).
